item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: PhotoEngineer 1.0.83
item.description:
RAW browsing, photo selection, and management

PhotoEngineer is a photo import, RAW viewing, and quick selection tool for Macs with Apple chips. It is ideal for organizing content from wedding photography, multi-day events, and collaborations involving multiple photographers. The software can quickly open memory cards or folders and supports star ratings, tags, color labels, and automatic stacking of burst shots, helping photographers focus on viewing candidate photos. When importing, you can first copy the photos to your Mac, then start selecting photos while a second copy is created in the background. Each copy will be re-read from the target disk and compared byte-by-byte with the memory card. Only after both copies have passed verification will you be prompted that the memory card can be safely formatted and ejected according to the settings. Projects can be pre-configured with event names, dates, storage, and backup locations. Media files are then automatically organized by shooting date and camera ownership, and ratings and tags are also synchronized to the backup drive. The software supports RAW, DNG, and various common image and video formats readable by macOS. Ratings and descriptions are written to sidecar files without altering the original RAW files.

item.title: Wormhole 1.5.0
item.description:
macOS Remote Access Software

Wormhole is a remote access and screen-sharing tool for Macs running macOS 14 and later. It allows you to directly control application windows on devices such as Mac mini and Mac Studio from your MacBook, and you can also view the entire remote screen as needed. Remote windows are displayed as separate windows, retaining Retina clarity, with their own Dock icons, and supporting switching via Command + Tab. Colored borders and device names help distinguish which Mac a window belongs to. The software supports mouse and keyboard control, window resizing, copying and pasting text, images, and files across devices, and dragging and dropping files to remote devices. It can also search for and launch remote applications that are not yet running. After the two Macs are paired using a six-digit code, an end-to-end encrypted connection is established directly, without the need to register an account. The developer's server does not handle screen images or keystroke data. When used across networks, you can connect by address using Tailscale or an existing network router. After a connection is interrupted, it can automatically reconnect, restore the previous window after a restart, and support waking up paired devices that are in sleep mode. This makes it suitable for daily collaboration between multiple Macs.

item.title: Diffacto 1.2.0
item.description:
macOS Semantic Diff Tool

Diffacto is a multi-format semantic diff and merge tool for Macs with Apple silicon. It supports macOS 15 and later and can handle code, structured data, databases, images, designs and 3D scenes, audio, video, documents, and binary packages. It not only checks files line by line, but also identifies function moves, variable renames, formatting adjustments, and changes to invisible characters, distinguishing between mechanical edits and changes that truly affect the content. For different files, the software provides specialized views such as key-matching data rows, read-only comparison of database structures, locating image area movements, aligning audio cuts, and identifying modifications to document clauses. Diffacto can integrate with Git, Jujutsu, Perforce, and Unity Version Control, supporting three-way merges, rename replays, folder comparisons, and semantic history tracking. It can also connect to tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via MCP, enabling step-by-step reviews of changes made by AI programming agents.

item.title: Deskathon 1.1.0
item.description:
Mac Cursor Movement Trajectory Statistics

Deskathon is an input activity statistics tool that resides in the Mac menu bar. It supports macOS 14 and later versions and can record the distance traveled by the mouse and trackpad pointers, the number of clicks, and scrolling activity, transforming everyday actions into intuitive landmarks and journeys. The software not only displays the movement data of the cursor on each monitor, but also presents the cumulative distance as a route, making long-term usage records more interesting. The heat map generated based on the display helps users understand the distribution of click locations and scrolling. The keystroke count feature is disabled by default. The number of keystrokes will only be counted after it is actively enabled and input monitoring permission is granted. The specific keys pressed are not recorded. All activity statistics are kept locally. There is no need to register an account, and the movement distance, clicks, scrolling, keypress count, heatmaps, and application or file names are not sent to the developer. You will be prompted each time before a crash report is sent. Error and unresponsiveness reports, as well as anonymous usage data, can be disabled in the settings. The free version can perform all types of counts, while the Pro version offers a complete history, more widgets, and cards, making it suitable for users who want to continuously monitor their Mac input habits.

item.title: Moment 2.3.1
item.description:
Mac Focus Timer

Moment Timer is a focus timer for deep work and study that views focus as a state of mind and body, not just a tool for improving productivity. Before starting the timer, you can set an intention for the current session and adjust the duration from 5 to 90 minutes. During the timer session, you can view the remaining time on devices such as the Mac menu bar, iPhone, and Apple Watch. The app supports alternating periods of focus and rest, and offers gentle rest suggestions at the end of each session. Users can also record a focus session, marking their own feelings from distracted to immersed, to observe which tasks, times, and habits are more likely to lead to a state of flow. The statistics feature compiles focus records from different devices. Advanced insights can analyze relevant patterns on the device side, and supported devices can also generate insights with the help of Apple Intelligence. Moment Timer offers themes and ambient sounds such as ocean, air, sand, and forest. It also supports playing Apple Music during focus sessions and can pause the music during breaks.

item.title: Pruneo 1.6.1
item.description:
Mac System Junk Cleaner

Pruneo is a free disk cleanup and space management tool for macOS that scans system and application data in seconds, identifying Docker, Node, Xcode, design, video, music, and local AI caches that are often overlooked by conventional cleanup software. The software automatically organizes scan classifications based on the applications and items actually installed and used, eliminating the need to manually select configuration files. It categorizes items into three levels: Safe, Requires Confirmation, and Locked. Before cleanup, you can review the file size and reason for deletion for each item. All items to be cleaned up will first be moved to the quarantine area, with the option to restore them within a specified period, reducing the risk of accidental deletion. There are non-disableable protection rules for system files, keys, credentials, iCloud Drive, photo libraries, email messages, project files, and other content. Pruneo also offers features such as duplicate files, large files, browser caches, Time Machine local snapshots, app uninstall residues, disk maps, CPU and memory monitoring, and process and port viewing. It can also access AI assistants like Claude Code and Codex via terminal commands or MCP.

item.title: Meeting Transcriber 0.9.0
item.description:
Mac Local Meeting Transcription

Meeting Transcriber is a privacy-focused meeting transcription tool for macOS 14.2 and later. It resides in the menu bar, automatically detects Teams, Zoom, and Webex meetings, records both application audio and microphone input, and performs transcription, speaker separation, and summary generation in the background after the meeting ends. The software offers two local speech recognition engines, WhisperKit and Parakeet, supporting multiple languages, custom models, specialized vocabulary, and terminology normalization. Combined with FluidAudio, it enables dual-track speaker separation and cross-meeting voiceprint recognition. Users can import various audio and video files for batch processing, or manually select recordings from the app. Processing results can be improved through silent trimming, optional echo cancellation, and transcription deduplication. Minutes generation can connect to local models such as Ollama and LM Studio, or you can choose the Claude CLI or an OpenAI-compatible interface. The output is a Markdown document containing summaries, topics, decisions, and to-do items. When using local models, processing can be done offline once the model is ready.

item.title: SiliconScope 4.9.2
item.description:
Mac Neural Engine Monitoring

SiliconScope is a native system monitoring software for Apple Silicon Macs, featuring a SwiftUI dashboard and customizable menu bar widgets. It allows users to view metrics such as processor, graphics chip, neural engine, media engine, and memory bandwidth without the need for sudo. It distinguishes between the utilization and actual frequency of CPU Efficiency and Performance cores, displays the power consumption, temperature, fan speed, memory pressure, and battery health of each hardware module, and uses AI load analysis to determine whether the local model is limited by bandwidth, computing power, cooling, or memory. The Process Inspector tracks the CPU, IPC, power consumption, disk activity, and Neural Engine memory usage of individual applications, helping to identify the sources of resource consumption. The recording and playback feature supports saving monitoring data as local files and reviewing instantaneous peaks through the timeline. Fleet's multi-device view also enables centralized monitoring of remote Mac, Linux NVIDIA hosts, and cloud servers, allowing you to view hardware status, models, and container information via an encrypted paired connection.

item.title: Lunar Pro 7.0.0b38
item.description:
Brightness Adjustment for Mac External Displays

Lunar is a display control tool for macOS that supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. It centrally manages the brightness, contrast, volume, and input sources of external displays. It prioritizes directly adjusting display hardware parameters via DDC, preserving more natural color rendition, and supports operating multiple screens using keyboard brightness keys, volume keys, and custom hotkeys. For different working environments, Lunar offers brightness synchronization, an ambient light sensor, scheduled timers, and an automatic adjustment mode based on the sun's position, allowing the external display to change according to the MacBook's brightness or the ambient light. At night, the dimming function can reduce glare by lowering the brightness below the screen's minimum level. Compatible XDR screens can also exceed conventional brightness limits. BlackOut allows you to turn off specific screens as needed, while FaceLight enables you to use the monitor as a fill light panel for video conferencing. The software also provides shortcut integration and a command-line interface, making it easy to set up monitor presets and automated processes. In connection environments where DDC is unavailable, you can choose Gamma dimming or use Raspberry Pi relay hardware control commands.

item.title: Motty 0.4.29
item.description:
Native SSH Client for Mac

Motty is a native SSH client for macOS that integrates a terminal, SFTP file management, port forwarding, VNC and RDP remote desktops, and an AI assistant into a single window. It is ideal for server maintenance, remote development, and multi-host management. The software is built using the Go and Viva frameworks, does not rely on Electron or an embedded browser, and supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs. The terminal offers multiple tabs, horizontal and vertical split screens, history search, session recording, input broadcasting, and over 200 color schemes. It also allows you to view the processor, memory, disk, and network status of the remote host in the sidebar. The file panel supports recursive transfer, breakpoint resume, permission adjustment, and remote text editing, and can also follow the terminal directory. Hosts can be organized by groups and tags, and connection configurations can be imported from tools such as OpenSSH, PuTTY, and MobaXterm. The built-in AI assistant can answer questions based on the terminal context, execute commands after approval, and provide tools to external agents through an optional MCP interface.

item.title: FanBar 0.11.0
item.description:
Mac Fan Control Tool

FanBar is a native macOS menu bar temperature monitoring and fan control tool that supports macOS 11 Big Sur and later for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs that can provide readable fan data via AppleSMC. The software displays the CPU temperature, average fan speed, or a combination of the two in the menu bar, and presents the temperature change through a scrolling chart for the last ten minutes, reading the GPU, SSD, and battery temperature when the hardware supports it. Everyday use keeps macOS under automatic thermal management, and after approving a signed control service, you can set a fixed speed, or choose mute, equalize, performance, and extreme thermal presets. Each preset has an independently editable temperature and speed curve that supports CPU, GPU or SSD temperature as the basis for adjustment, and can also restore system control after a specified time. The software provides protection against high-temperature notifications, hardware rpm limits, and attempts to restore automatic control in the event of an abnormality. macOS 14 and later also adds a desktop widget to view the heat dissipation status, and the widget refresh is scheduled by the system.

item.title: Side Screen 1.2.1
item.description:
Android Tablet to Mac Sidescreen

Side Screen is an open source tool that turns an Android tablet into a Mac extended display, supports USB-C wired connections and WiFi wireless connections within the same LAN, creates a true virtual display, and allows users to drag windows directly onto the tablet to expand office, programming, and data access spaces. The software passes through the Mac side H. 265 Hardware coding and Android hardware decoding transmission screen, combined with asynchronous processing pipeline to reduce latency, and support touch operation and touch prediction, making clicks and drags more natural. Users can adjust up to 8K resolution, 30 to 120 fps frame rate, transmission bit rate, and quality presets, as well as turn on HiDPI mode to adapt to high-resolution tablets with clearer text and icons. Wireless mode automatically reconnects after the first scan pairing, and the authorization token is generated locally and can be reset. Game Enhancement Mode provides presets for high frame rates and low latency, while Login Launch and Automatic Streaming are suitable for non-monitor scenarios with the Mac mini, Mac Studio, or laptop closed.

item.title: YesPlayMusic 3.0.0
item.description:
Third-party NetEase Cloud Music Player

YesPlayMusic is a visually appealing third-party NetEase Cloud Music player that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms. It is developed using the Vue.js full-stack framework and offers features such as NetEase Cloud account login, music video playback, lyric display, private FM, and daily recommendations. The app does not include social features, supports direct playback for users outside China, and can replace grayed-out song links through UnblockNeteaseMusic. YesPlayMusic offers special features such as daily automatic check-in, automatic switching between light and dark modes, Touch Bar support, and custom keyboard shortcuts. Users can easily install it via Homebrew and Scoop, and the project also offers deployment options for Docker and Vercel. The open-source license is based on the MIT license, making it suitable for personal study and research. YesPlayMusic is a visually appealing third-party NetEase Cloud Music player that supports multiple platforms (including Windows, macOS, and Linux) and offers a wide range of features. It also provides seamless access to NetEase Cloud Music resources, offering users a convenient music playback experience.

item.title: Typeflux 1.0.0
item.description:
macOS Native Voice Input

Typeflux is an open-source, free voice input assistant for macOS. It allows you to start speaking by pressing the Fn key and stop by releasing it. It can quickly transcribe natural speech into the text boxes of almost any application, reducing the burden of switching input methods and manual typing. It comes with built-in support for local speech recognition models, so there's no need to upload speech data to the cloud. This ensures offline availability and places a greater emphasis on privacy and security. The software not only provides basic speech-to-text functionality, but also includes the "Ask Anything" voice AI assistant, which can be activated by double-clicking the Fn key to perform Q&A, rewriting, translation, summarization, and more complex natural language operations. Typeflux also supports creating different personas based on scenarios such as work, study, and social interactions, matching more professional or more colloquial recognition and output styles. The interface remains minimalist and resides in the menu bar, making it suitable for macOS users who want to perform voice input efficiently, quietly, and privately. Typeflux is an open-source, free macOS voice input assistant that features key-triggered activation, natural speech, fast transcription, and local privacy protection.

item.title: Warp 0.2026.11.18.08.17.stable_05
item.description:
Powerful Modern Smart Ai Terminal Tools

Warp is a modern terminal and intelligent coding environment for macOS developers that combines traditional command lines, AI coding agents, multi-model scheduling, and team-level governance capabilities in one workflow. Starting from the terminal experience, it supports developers to directly call Claude Code, Codex, Warp Agent and other agents locally. It can also extend the task to run in the cloud through the Oz Agent Platform, which is suitable for complex software engineering scenarios such as code generation, problem troubleshooting, refactoring migration, PR preliminary examination and incident response. Warp Terminal is open source, emphasizing an open agent ecosystem, connectivity to any tool, choice of inference providers and models, and providing codebase indexing, fine-grained permission control, usage visibility, and enterprise compliance capabilities to enable individual developers and teams to organize automated development tasks more efficiently in a familiar command-line interface.

item.title: 010 Editor 17.0.2
item.description:
Professional Hexadecimal and Text Editing Tool

010 Editor is a professional hex and text editor that supports macOS and is suitable for tasks such as binary format analysis, reverse engineering, digital forensics, and data recovery. The software uses Binary Templates to parse raw bytes into a clearly structured data hierarchy, supporting the parsing and editing of over 330 formats. Templates can be downloaded or shared through the built-in template repository. Text editing uses Tree-sitter for real-time syntax parsing, supports over 45 syntaxes, and offers syntax highlighting, bracket matching, column mode editing, and unlimited undo. It can handle large files exceeding 50 GB. The binary analysis tools cover find and replace for various data types, byte-by-byte file comparison, checksum and hash calculation, byte histograms, and data visualization, and support disassembly for multiple processor architectures. Users can also use C/C++-like scripts to automate editing operations, perform batch processing via the command line, and debug templates and scripts with breakpoints and monitoring features. The data checker, bookmarks, expression calculator, and various encoding and data format conversion tools provide support for checking and modifying complex files.

item.title: Bluebird 3.15.2
item.description:
Learning Work Focus Timing Tool

Bluebird is a time management app for learning and working that combines a pomodoro-based focus timer and to-do list to help users overcome procrastination, stay focused, and make progress. Its main features include a flexible focus timer, a simple yet powerful task management tool that supports recording time, background sound provisioning, interference blocking, and widgets on the home screen and lock screen. In addition, Bluebird supports live activity on Dynamic Island, syncs via iCloud between iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac, and ensures accessibility (like VoiceOver and Dynamic Type). It also has full focus support, SharePlay features, Siri shortcuts, and automation. The app adheres to a strict privacy policy and does not collect user data, making it suitable for students, remote workers, or anyone who wants to use their time wisely. Bluebird also offers an Apple Watch version that keeps you focused without your iPhone, while providing instant sync, vibration alerts, and more.

item.title: Pinning 2.4
item.description:
Life Story Recording Tool

Pinning – Countdown Events is a powerful countdown and event management app that combines a simple calendar viewer to help users record life stories and track project milestones. Users can easily create a variety of events and organize them in a notebook with a dedicated list of birthdays and anniversaries built in, so important days can be seen at a glance. Events are presented as timelines with support for custom icons or emojis that highlight the countdown or positive timing. The app provides beautiful homepage widgets and lock screen widgets to keep your most important events on your desktop or lock screen for easy viewing at any time. Pinning supports iCloud collaboration for sharing important events with family and friends, as well as syncing upcoming calendar events and scheduled reminders. Users can create recurring events and set notification reminders, use Siri shortcuts to quickly save a single event or event list as a picture, or even import data from a birthday calendar or create a new event from a calendar. Whether tracking birthdays, anniversaries, or managing day-to-day tasks and long-term projects, Pinning delivers the ultimate experience in elegant design and seamless operation for users seeking efficient living records and event planning.

item.title: NookX 2026.11.22
item.description:
Smart Island Dynamic Interactive Tool

Designed for macOS, Nook X is an efficient interactive tool that emulates Liu Haiping and offers a variety of personalized features such as date, time, weather temperature display, quick launch, and to-do widgets. With Nook X, users can turn the Liuhai area into an information center, greatly improving the utilization of screen space. The tool offers a wealth of customization options that allow users to tailor the display and style to their individual needs, enhancing productivity while blending seamlessly with desktop style. Personalized display: Nook X can display information such as date, time, weather temperature, etc. Users can customize the display content according to their needs and create a personalized dashboard. Quick launch: Users can quickly launch common applications through Nook X for convenient and efficient work. To-do widget: integrate to-do function to help users manage daily tasks and improve work efficiency. Temporary Notes feature: allows users to quickly take temporary notes, making it easy to capture inspiration or important information at any time.

item.title: Unread 5.2.1
item.description:
Reeder Alternative/RSS Feed Tool

Unread, an RSS reader designed to help users rediscover the joy of reading, offers beautiful typography, good handling of feed-only feeds, and a variety of color themes for Mac, iPhone, and iPad. Unread highlighted the free sync between devices via the Unread Cloud service, which also supports syncing with services like Feedbin, Feedly, Fever, Inoreader, and NewsBlur. For feeds that only include a post feed, Unread automatically displays the full text on the webpage, and users can freely switch between the feed text and the webpage text, or even set the default webpage text display for a single feed. Unread offers "Subscribe in Unread" and "Save to Unread" sharing extensions that make it easy for users to subscribe to websites or save posts while browsing the web (subscription required). Unread also offers a variety of color themes, widgets to display the number of latest or unread articles, comprehensive VoiceOver support, web text and image caching for instant loading and offline access (subscription required), and native support for a variety of later-reading services.

item.title: LitPads SoundBoard 1.9.13
item.description:
Mac Live Audio Routing Tool

LitPads is a custom soundboard app for musicians, DJs, podcasters, live streamers, theater and live event voice controls, and content creators that creates multiple soundboards on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, imports your own audio files, and triggers playback with ultra-low latency. It supports one-time triggering, looping, switching, press-and-hold playback and other modes. Each Pad can independently adjust the volume, audio, fade, EQ, tone change, clip range and reverb, and provide multi-voice playback. It is suitable for live performances, program crossovers, stage prompts, church and theater cue, TikTok/Reels material production, and live workflows such as OBS, Twitch, YouTube Live, Discord, and Zoom. The Mac side can be used with virtual audio drivers for audio routing. Functions such as MIDI control, track serialization, automatic depression, global fade-out, cue list, and iCloud synchronization make complex performance processes easier to manage.

item.title: Verso 1.0.73
item.description:
Native Lightweight Word Processor

Verso Writer is a native lightweight word processor for macOS that emphasizes fast startup, focused writing, and reliable document compatibility. It opens and saves DOCX, Markdown, RTF, ODT, TXT and other common formats for collaboration between Microsoft Word, Google Docs, LibreOffice, GitHub and other workflows. The software provides compact toolbars, elegant page layout, focus mode, paperless mode, a variety of page appearance, table of contents, annotations, revisions, footnotes, header and footer, tables, images, find replacements and word count and other writing and typesetting capabilities. Markdown files can be visually edited and preserved in rich text, and code blocks support syntax highlighting; BibTeX and CSL JSON reference management can generate references in multiple formats. The app is built with SwiftUI and AppKit. It does not rely on Electron, web view or cloud account. The interface supports multiple languages. It is suitable for Mac writers who need low burden, privacy-friendly, and full-featured.

item.title: StepGrab 1.7.2
item.description:
Creating Step-by-Step Tutorials for macOS

StepGrab is a workflow recording and step-by-step tutorial generation tool that resides in the macOS menu bar. It automatically recognizes interactions as users click through workflows, captures screenshots for each click, numbers the steps, and generates coherent and accurate operating instructions, eliminating the repetitive work of taking screenshots one by one and manually writing documentation. It accurately captures menus, drop-down lists, pop-up windows, system selectors, double-clicks, keyboard shortcuts, and scroll indicators, and arranges the visuals with rounded corners and shadows that closely resemble native Mac windows. The app supports exporting the results as a looping GIF, an animated PDF, or an HD MP4. You can also adjust the color scheme, numbering style, layout, PDF quality, light or dark appearance, and add a brand logo. On-device AI can help generate more natural step-by-step instructions, while text recognition and element localization can improve the accuracy of menu and pop-up descriptions. The entire screen processing procedure is completed locally on the Mac. There is no need to upload the recorded content to the cloud, and you can start using it without an account.

item.title: Anybox 2.16
item.description:
Organize bookmarks across devices

Anybox is a cross-platform bookmark management and read later app that seamlessly syncs across iPhone, iPad, and Mac devices to help users easily save and organize web links, notes, and images. Anybox provides a powerful system of nested tags and folders that give users the flexibility to categorize their bookmarks, while enabling the creation of smart lists that automatically categorize content based on attributes such as title, date added, and more. Users can quickly save links via the global system share menu, or import bookmarks directly from within a browser or third-party app. The Anybox built-in keyboard extension allows for quick input of frequently used links and notes; it also supports widget tracking of reading lists or one-click saving of clipboard contents to specified document sets. Anybox uses iCloud sync, does not collect any personal data, and pays attention to user privacy protection. Simple and smooth interface, powerful search function, support for focus search bookmarks, images and files can also be saved and viewed. Anybox is suitable for knowledge workers, researchers, and users who need to organize network resources on a daily basis, greatly improving information management efficiency through intelligent classification and shortcuts, and making bookmark organization orderly and accessible.

item.title: Bear 熊掌记 3.0.5
item.description:
Markdown Writing and Note Taking Tools

BearMaster is an elegant and easy-to-use Markdown writing software designed to help users capture inspiration, write conveniently, and plan to-dos to keep life organized. It is suitable for people from all walks of life, such as writers, lawyers, chefs, CEOs, teachers, doctors, engineers, students and parents, and is extremely easy to use, without the need to register or create an account to get started. Bear Bearmaster supports a variety of text formats, including right-to-left languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, and Farsi, and can easily create notes through Siri and shortcuts, emphasizing privacy and ensuring the privacy of users' notes. It supports a flexible Markdown language that makes text easy to migrate and preserves various Markdown formats. Users can efficiently organize their notes through tags and to-dos, and easily share notes to any third-party app. Bear Bearmaster also offers deep search capabilities, including searching for images and text in PDFs (requires a Bear Pro subscription).

item.title: Audio One 1.24.0
item.description:
Audio Music Editing and Conversion Tool

Audio One is a full-featured and user-friendly audio editing tool that is perfectly suited for Mac and ideal for both audio production beginners and experienced sound designers. This app offers a multi-track editor with a wide range of features, including sound recording and processing, mixing and mastering (vocals and beats or instruments), a format converter (supporting WAV, AIFF, AU, FLAC, MP3, AAC, AC3, M4R, M4A, CAF, AIFC, etc.), editing tags and track covers, and support for various effects (such as pitch, speed, reverb, delay, equalizer, high-pass filter, low-pass filter, notch filter, low-pass filter). low-pass and high-pass filters, peak limiters, etc.), an extensive sound library (offering high-quality sounds and melodies to inspire creativity), audio file length adjustment, three-band and ten-band equalizers, ringtone creation, and keyboard shortcut functionality. In short, Audio One is the ideal audio editing tool you've been looking for. Audio One is a feature-rich and user-friendly audio tool that is fully compatible with your Mac. In short, this is exactly what you're looking for.

Mac HD Wallpaper Library

Wallpapers Qingyun Wallpaper is a 4K HD wallpaper software specially developed for Mac, designed to provide users with fresh and beautiful Mac wallpapers. The software has carefully selected thousands of 4K wallpapers to ensure that each desktop background delivers a stunning visual experience. Wallpapers recommends HD Mac wallpapers to help users find their favorite Mac desktop wallpapers faster. Install Wallpapers to make your screen stunning and fun. The software features include a wide variety of beautiful wallpaper materials that are continuously updated, so users don't have to spend time searching for materials; it is easy to use, with one-click setup; it supports multiple screen aspect ratios and native resolutions; and wallpapers are updated every Wednesday (Plus version). Wallpapers is a 4K HD wallpaper software developed specifically for Mac, designed to provide fresh and beautiful Mac wallpapers, making every desktop background look stunning. Curated 4K Wallpapers: Thousands of 4K wallpapers have been carefully selected to ensure that every desktop background is visually stunning. item.title: Caplio 1.4.4
item.description:
Mac Image OCR Search

Caplio is a screenshot and image management tool designed specifically for Mac. It can turn images in user-specified folders into a private, searchable visual library. It uses on-device text recognition technology to extract text from screenshots and images, allowing users to quickly locate target files by image content, file name, category, app name, or date. Even if they forget the original file name, they can still find the information they need. The app displays image previews, recognized text, file information, and categories in a timeline format. It also supports monitoring multiple folders and automatically adding new images. Users can keep files in their original locations or organize them into folders by date or category, preview changes, and restore moved files when needed. Once you find an image, you can drag it directly into other apps, documents, or messages. You can also copy the image, copy the recognized text, share the image and its extracted text, open the original file, modify the displayed title and category, and preview it with Quick Look.

item.title: Task Flow 5.2
item.description:
Task Management and Project Collaboration Tools

Task Flow is an innovative task management app designed for iPhone and iPad. It is available for free download and supports Dark Mode. With its unique multi-project task integration and list and Kanban layouts (including segmented lists and Kanban pipelines), it helps users optimize their workflows. The core "My Task Flow" concept allows users to select upcoming tasks from different projects and handle them together to avoid distractions, and the focus timer further enhances productivity. Enhancing efficiency, it also features subtasks, attachment management, due date selection, notification settings, and more. Its interface is visually appealing and straightforward, suitable for various project needs. User feedback has been positive, and new features are continuously being added. Thoughtfully developed by a Canadian team, it empowers users to complete tasks efficiently and maintain productivity.

item.title: Posterino 6.5
item.description:
Professional Photo Collage Maker

Posterino is a professional photo collage software that allows you to easily create stunning collages, posters, and greeting cards, instantly transforming your photos into precious memories worth sharing. Whether you're celebrating a trip, surprising a friend, or capturing a special moment, Posterino can help you turn beautiful moments into stunning keepsakes. You can start with a template, add photos, and watch the collage take shape in real time. Users can flexibly adjust the positions, try different styles, and fine-tune every detail. Posterino combines simplicity and powerful features, offering smart layouts, creative freedom, custom controls, smart auto-cropping, and face blurring to make your collages look perfect. The software supports various output formats, such as posters, postcards, calendars, contact sheets, or unique greeting cards, and can be easily shared on social media. Optimized for Mac, compatible with Apple Silicon, and supports macOS Dark and Light modes as well as high-resolution displays. For professional users, Posterino also supports batch automatic cropping, custom templates and sizes, metadata overlays, and variable image counts to meet more advanced creative needs.

item.title: Splice 1.5.1
item.description:
Quick Input of Animated Emojis on Mac

Splice is a quick emoji and GIF input tool for macOS. It brings Slack-like colon triggers and animated GIF searches to any input scenario in the system, allowing users to find the right reaction with just a few keystrokes in chats, emails, documents, or collaboration tools. It supports entering trigger words like :sparkles to display matching emojis as inline candidates, and combines fuzzy search, frequency-based sorting, and number shortcuts for selection, reducing the time spent manually browsing. The software also provides a full Emoji Board and GIF Board, making it easy to browse, search, and insert emojis or GIFs. GIFs can be sent as links or files, and frequently used GIFs can be saved and assigned custom keywords. Both keyboard shortcuts and triggers can be customized, making the overall experience more suitable for Mac users who engage in extensive chatting, community management, remote collaboration, and who like to use emojis to express tone.

item.title: Notchy 2.0.13
item.description:
macOS bangs augmentation tool

Notchy is a native macOS agile island and efficiency tool that turns the bangs area of the screen into an interactive control center that can run as a suspended capsule on Macs and external monitors without bangs. The software integrates music playback, synchronized lyrics, clipboard history, file staging, pomodoro timing, window snapping, and system status prompts to focus common actions at the top of the screen, reducing the number of switching windows and lookup menus. For development scenarios, it can track the usage, quota window and expenses of Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other tools, and display the execution status of agent activities, permission requests and long-time commands. Face unlocking is achieved through camera, Apple Vision local recognition and live detection. Facial features and passwords are saved in the macOS keychain, which is a convenient unlocking function, not equivalent to the infrared depth recognition of Apple Face ID. Notchy also provides app-independent volume, AirPods battery, OCR image text search, meeting suggestions, calendar reminders, and shortcut entries to support custom panels, gestures, and multiple real-time events displayed side-by-side.
